_comment: Hand-written one-liners for UGens whose .schelp has no summary:: tag. Keys override extracted summaries; entries may also set a category path.

AccelerometerX.summary: Accelerometer X-axis sensor input (device builds), scaled via minval/maxval/warp/lag.

AccelerometerY.summary: Accelerometer Y-axis sensor input (device builds), scaled via minval/maxval/warp/lag.

AccelerometerZ.summary: Accelerometer Z-axis sensor input (device builds), scaled via minval/maxval/warp/lag.

BlockSize.summary: Outputs the server's block size (samples per control-rate period).

ClearBuf.summary: Zeroes the contents of a buffer.

ListDUGen.summary: Base for demand-rate list UGens that sequence values from a list.

NodeID.summary: Outputs the node ID of the synth containing this UGen.

ScopeOut2.summary: Writes a signal to a ScopeBuffer for oscilloscope display.

SetBuf.summary: Writes a list of values into a buffer at init time.
